sources.title: GitHub - Mensamayne/dustmap: A report-only map of dead code, copies, ...
sources.snippet: Optional models (separate download, MIT): embedding package and pair judge on Hugging Face. Text-only detectors work without them. Needs Node 20+. Not on npm yet. git clone https://github.com/Mensamayne/dustmap.git cd dustmap npm ci # Windows PowerShell: Set-Alias dustmap "node $PWD/packages/cli/bin/dustmap.mjs" # bash: alias dustmap="node $PWD/packages/cli/bin/dustmap.mjs"
